description: This file contains React testing utilities, including mock authentication setup, rendering components with providers, and mocking fetch responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Sets the authentication state using provided auth data or default test auth.

methods.name: renderWithProviders
methods.description: Renders a React element within testing library, optionally with custom options.

methods.name: mockFetchOnceJson
methods.description: Mocks the global fetch function to return a JSON response with provided data.

methods.name: mockFetchOnceError
methods.description: Mocks the global fetch function to return an error response with a message.

methods.name: expectLastFetchHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the headers of the last fetch call match expected headers.
